versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **gpt-taste**, an elite UX/UI and advanced GSAP motion engineering skill.
- Enforces Python-driven true randomization to guarantee unique layout, motion, and component variance.
- Adheres strictly to the AIDA page framework, enforcing ultra-wide, low-line-count hero text and massive section spacing.
- Mandates mathematically perfect, gapless bento grids (`grid-flow-dense`), and bans common poor design defaults (meta-labels, 6-line wraps, stamp icons).
- Requires a <design_plan> with deterministic mock-Python output before writing UI, verifying all core directives are met.
- Integrates advanced GSAP paradigms: scroll triggers, pinning, scrubbing, and card stacking, ensuring every element features responsive, cinematic motion.
